notes.title: My Room Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/13a57e3f6de964b9b782b44d196e604dd97809a0.png"]

My Room is getting new content!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/2cf7f9a0d3adff7da741d69dc4081e2fa0246ae7.png"]

My Room lets you view your best clear time, how many times you've cleared the stage, and your score.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/544ccdfa105955b3fbd6ca4349770ba5280fedd9.png"]

Each time you clear a stage, a new jelly will be added to My Room.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/305d2a9b74d92eca9d0ca8899228e2abc8a29a9b.png"]

These jellies are also visible during gameplay.

notes.notes:

notes.title: New Season Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/a4e8ccea4ce10c8ceacbd504b6c8b58bfce6e012.png"]

A new season update for Flying Pudding is scheduled to be released.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/89ed42c5cdb6ad540443c65e40cb8fd36ebfbefe.gif"]

A new map called “Dive” will be added.

A new difficulty level is also planned.



The existing design has been updated.

The ranking system will be discontinued, and it will no longer be possible to register new rankings.

Players currently listed in the rankings will be recorded in the Hall of Fame.



Score saving and related features will be added in the future.
